A_STRUCTURAL_CHECK_I_MADE_RATHER_THAN_AS.what_it_would_have_meant_if_they_DIFFERE: a repost fill model changing a path that reposts nothing -- which would have been a defect in the leg, not a property of the arms. The check costs one comparison and rules that out.

WHY_MY_STRUCK_25_PERCENT_BAR_WAS_ANCHORE.THE_OBSERVATION: my 0.25*|D| bar would have been a PLAUSIBLE threshold for FILL-MODEL sensitivity -- CONDVALUE's leg moves 22.2 % of |D|, just under it. I applied that bar to ERA-GAP sensitivity, which REV bounds at 18.4c-1,036.5c, two orders smaller.
WHY_MY_STRUCK_25_PERCENT_BAR_WAS_ANCHORE.the_lesson_stated_as_a_mechanism: I anchored a threshold on the magnitude of a DIFFERENT perturbation of the same quantity. Both are 'how much can D move', and only one of them was the question. A threshold needs the physics of the SPECIFIC perturbation it gates, not a plausible fraction of the headline number.
WHY_MY_STRUCK_25_PERCENT_BAR_WAS_ANCHORE.and_it_is_the_same_shape_as_the_night_s_: a number that is right about one object attached to another
